app_store.name: Games 4 All
app_store.subtitle: Calm learning games, no ads
app_store.promotional_text: Sixty calm games that grow with your child — counting, reading, memory and logic, plus games to play together. Offline, no ads, nothing to buy.
app_store.description:
Games 4 All is sixty short, calm games for children and the grown-ups who play with them — counting, reading, memory, logic, timing, and games to play together on one device.

EVERY GAME TEACHES SOMETHING
• Numbers: counting, number bonds, telling the time, number patterns, place value
• Words: spelling, rhymes, word ladders, letter codes
• Memory and logic: pairs, sequences, sudoku, mazes, deduction, symmetry
• Sorting and shapes: size order, shadows, patterns, odd one out
• Timing and arcade: gentle reflex games where a bump is only a bump
• Together: five co-operative games for the whole family on one phone or tablet — one team, no winner

GROWS WITH YOUR CHILD
Each game has six levels. A clean round moves the next one up a level; a rough one steps down. Each profile sees the games that suit its age, from 3 to adult.

BUILT TO BE PUT DOWN
Every round has a fixed end. There are no scores, streaks, bests, daily rewards or endless modes — nothing to chase. A friendly sportsperson's quote cheers each round on.

FOR GROWN-UPS
• Profiles for each player, with nicknames picked from a list — the app never asks for a real name
• Play-time limits per sitting and per day; a limit lets the round in progress finish, and a break is a real break
• Settings sit behind a grown-ups-only question
• Large buttons, screen-reader labels, colour never the only signal, and a reduced-motion setting

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Works entirely offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no analytics, no tracking — and no data collected at all. Everything stays on the device.
